$comment: Canonical truth table for Oracle Arena. Inputs a,b are integers in [0, 2147483647]. All results fit in a signed 64-bit integer. These semantics are authoritative; the SDK and validator must match them exactly.

functions.name: mod1
functions.note: b+1 avoids div-by-zero; b+1 fits since b<2^31

functions.name: popcount2
functions.note: count of set bits in each, summed

functions.name: mulmod_p
functions.note: p = 2^31-1 (Mersenne prime); a*b < 2^62 so no overflow before mod

functions.name: sumsq
functions.note: sum of squares; max 2*(2^31-1)^2 < i64 max
